selection_rule: Within the high-SNR matched, 0-to-10-dB matched, and below-0-dB unmatched/no-candidate strata, select the record nearest the stratum median SNR; break ties by event and station identifier.
claim_boundary: Illustrative examples; no inferential metric is computed from selected records.
export_note: Waveforms are the stored display-scaled traces, not raw physical-unit acceleration. Blank scores denote stored NaN, not zero. All 480 stored packet scores per record retained; plotting range is marked. No new inference.
